blurb: AI researcher specializing in continual pretraining, and benchmarking open-ended and agentic systems.
Ten years of machine learning research experience across startups, industry labs, and academia.
Published at NeurIPS, CVPR, ACL, and ICCV, with 750+ citations and two patents.

points: Developed methods and benchmarks for continual pretraining, open-ended evaluation, inferring mechanisms from behavior, and scaling synthetic RL environments.
Built ONEBench, enabling reliable model ranking with up to 95% of evaluations missing, and RevengeBench, testing 12 frontier LLM agents on 75 hidden policies.

experience.org: Microsoft Research, Mixed Reality & AI Lab
points: Owned a parametric 3D face model used by 30+ researchers across multiple teams.
Rebuilt the training, evaluation, and visualization infrastructure, and led a research effort that reduced the average fitting error by half.
Built a real-time deep learning system for novel view synthesis, demoed at MSR TechFest.
Initiated Project Paidia, integrating MSR's RL library into Ninja Theory's upcoming title, and implemented a reverse curriculum that doubled sample efficiency over PPO.
Owned the product telemetry pipeline. Identified an opportunity to improve web index retrieval, secured leadership backing, and built the initial deep learning model.
Implemented LTE control plane features and designed system and component tests.
